name: Karisa Derapasu Iepesu
original_name: カリサ・デラパス・イエペス
source:
A hopeless sister who only does her job half-heartedly, as if she were a temporary part-timer.
She is a well-informed person who loves gossip and despite her appearance, she's also a kind-hearted person who students can turn to when they're in trouble.
translation:
